svg.title: Counter tally for listen and silent
svg.desc: Two tally tables built with collections.Counter. Counter of listen and Counter of silent both count the letters e, i, l, n, s and t once each, so the tables match and the words are anagrams.

g.text: Same letters with the same counts, so the two words are anagrams
